title: Ship a polished Board milestone and define Architect absorption boundaries
summary: Deliver one polished standalone product milestone for internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace: open repository-backed product truth, edit a screen or diagram, review a proposal, hand it to Codex, and reconcile implementation. The slice must prove user value, UI/UX quality, performance, accessibility, recovery, and the declared monetization or non-monetization posture.
acceptance_criteria: The slice is centered on one complete journey: open repository-backed product truth, edit a screen or diagram, review a proposal, hand it to Codex, and reconcile implementation.
Document the current user problem, baseline evidence, intended outcome, and success signal before changing UI or architecture.
Define one obvious entry point and a clear completion or safe-abort state.
Loading, empty, error, offline, stale, permission-denied, partial, and recovery states are designed intentionally rather than falling through to generic copy.
The visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, motion, controls, and feedback use repository-owned design tokens and components.
The journey is usable with relevant accessibility technologies and input modes.
English and Czech or the repository's declared locales receive equivalent meaning and correctly formatted dynamic values.
The journey stays inside the approved performance budgets and includes before-and-after evidence for its critical interactions.
Diagnostics and product feedback remain privacy-safe, explicit, and proportionate to the repository role.
Monetization follows `internal-now-optional-commercialization-later`; if monetization is not applicable, the UX contains no artificial upgrade or revenue pressure.
Agent or automation assistance is optional, transparent, reversible, and never required for the basic user value.
No cross-application integration or product merger is introduced unless the journey itself proves a concrete need.
Focused behavior tests and visual or runtime evidence cover the normal, failure, and recovery paths.
The implementation does not bundle unrelated architecture cleanup.
Repo-owned status, product documentation, and evidence are refreshed after the slice.
The strongest practical repository gate passes with zero app-owned warnings.
Document the current fusion posture: Likely destination for selected Architect capabilities; Board and design editing remain its core.
Identify which capabilities belong to the standalone product, which could become a shared module, and which must remain isolated by permissions or data ownership.
Any proposed absorption has an incremental pilot, migration plan, rollback, and user-facing mental-model review; no merger is performed in this ticket.

agent_notes: Standalone product excellence is the default; cross-app behavior is optional and evidence-driven.
Do not introduce monetization when the repository classification says it is internal, personal, or portfolio-only.
Do not hide performance regressions or app-owned warnings.
Product role: internal visual product, design, diagram, and proposal workspace.
Fusion posture: Likely destination for selected Architect capabilities; Board and design editing remain its core..
Non-scope: do not introduce unrelated cross-app integration, product merger, release, deployment, or monetization mechanics.
Alternative considered and rejected: applying one universal integration or monetization model to every app would damage product focus and ownership.
Wave 10 final rationalization: active-professionalization; portfolio band next. Professional quality and flagship scope feed the Wave 10 charter and baseline.
Wave 11 execution reconciliation: `required-prerequisite`. Use the Wave 11 implementation program as the delivery entry point while preserving this ticket's evidence and intent.

Wave 12 deep reassessment: decision `retain-required`, relevance `now`, current priority `high`, execution gate `reconcile with current repository before implementation`. Professional quality, product role, performance, accessibility, agents, and monetization fit remain required baselines.
Wave 13 human-validation reassessment: `retain-professional-baseline` / `now` / priority `high`. Professional baseline is required before user validation or release claims.

Final Wave 14 validity review: `valid`; publication `publish-after-fresh-reconciliation`; implementation sequence `after-sudoku`. Professional baseline is required before user validation or release claims.
